items.t: Relatlimab 加纳武单抗与纳武单抗治疗晚期黑色素瘤：3 期 RELATIVITY-047 试验的 5 年生存率和生物标志物分析
items.te: Relatlimab plus nivolumab versus nivolumab for advanced melanoma: 5-year survival and biomarker analyses of the phase 3 RELATIVITY-047 trial
items.s: 根据 RELATIVITY-047 试验，纳武单抗联合 relatlimab 被批准用于治疗晚期黑色素瘤；然而，需要长期数据。在这项预先指定的 5 年分析中，最短随访时间为 57.3 个月，纳武单抗联合 relatlimab 证明，与纳武单抗相比，在 PFS（风险比 = 0.77；95% 置信区间：0.65–0.92）、OS（风险比 = 0.78；95% 置信区间：0.64–0.95）和 MSS（风险比 = 0.71；95% 置信区间：0.57–0.88）。
items.se: Nivolumab plus relatlimab is approved for advanced melanoma based on the RELATIVITY-047 trial; however, long-term data are needed. In this prespecified 5-year analysis, with a minimum follow-up of 57.3 months, nivolumab plus relatlimab demonstrated continued clinically significant benefit versus nivolumab for PFS (hazard ratio = 0.77; 95% confidence interval: 0.65–0.92), OS (hazard ratio = 0.78; 95% confidence interval: 0.64–0.95), and MSS (hazard ratio = 0.71; 95% confidence interval: 0.57–0.88).

editorial.reason: RELATIVITY-047 的 5 年预设分析提供了迄今最长的双免随访数据，PFS/OS/MSS 均有生存曲线分离且附带 LAG-3 相关生物标志物探索，对黑色素瘤免疫治疗策略与耐药机制研究有实质参考价值；主要限制是生物标志物为探索性/事后分析，因果解释需谨慎，摘要级信息不足以评估亚组分析细节。

items.t: 14 天与 28 天三氟尿苷-替匹拉西加贝伐单抗治疗难治性转移性结直肠癌 (PRABITAS)：一项在日本进行的实用、多中心、开放标签、随机、3 期非劣效性试验。
items.te: 14-day versus 28-day trifluridine-tipiracil plus bevacizumab for refractory metastatic colorectal cancer (PRABITAS): a pragmatic, multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3, non-inferiority trial in Japan.
items.s: 背景曲氟尿苷-替吡嘧啶 (FTD-TPI) 联合贝伐珠单抗是难治性转移性结直肠癌的标准治疗方法。然而，常规方案经常与血液学和胃肠道毒性相关，这具有临床意义并且与患者相关。已提出简化的 14 天治疗方案以减少毒性，但随机试验尚未确定这种治疗是否能保留生存。因此，我们的目的是评估 14 天的计划是否不劣于传统的总生存期计划。方法 PRABITAS 是一项在日本 178 家医院进行的务实、多中心、开放标签、随机、3 期非劣效性试验。
items.se: Background Trifluridine-tipiracil (FTD-TPI) plus bevacizumab is the standard treatment for refractory metastatic colorectal cancer. However, the conventional schedule is frequently associated with haematological and gastrointestinal toxicity, which is clinically significant and relevant to patients. A simplified 14-day schedule has been proposed to reduce toxicity, but whether this treatment preserves survival has not been established in a randomised trial. We therefore aimed to assess whether the 14-day schedule is non-inferior to the conventional schedule for overall survival. Methods PRABITAS was a pragmatic, multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3, non-inferiority trial conducted in 178 hospitals in Japan.

editorial.reason: 随机III期非劣效试验（972例）显示14天给药方案总生存不劣于标准28天方案且显著降低中性粒细胞减少等毒性，可直接影响难治性转移性结直肠癌的处方实践和后续研究设计。局限为开放标签设计、日本单国实施，两例治疗相关死亡需关注。

items.t: 对错误临床人工智能的人工监督和决策支持系统审查和荟萃分析
items.te: Human oversight of erroneous clinical AI and decision support a systematic review and meta analysis
items.s: 人工智能 (AI) 越来越多地支持临床决策，但只有当临床医生认识到并抵制错误输出时，人类监督才具有保护作用。我们系统地回顾了临床医生对不正确的自动建议的反应的对照研究和现实世界研究。 46 份报告代表 41 个独立群组，其中包括 40 个核心群组。在三个调整后的队列中，临床医生正确的自动建议的正确性明显高于错误的自动建议（汇总 OR 10.19，95% CI 7.43–13.98；I² = 0%）； a ≥ 2020 的敏感性分析相似但不精确（OR 9.22，95% CI 2.06–41.13）。在四项异构真实世界计算机心电图研究中，26.6% 的错误解释未被纠正或识别（95% CI 6.4–65.6%；I² = 95.8%）。
items.se: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly supports clinical decisions, but human oversight is protective only if clinicians recognize and resist erroneous output. We systematically reviewed controlled and real-world studies of clinician responses to incorrect automated advice. Forty-six reports represented 41 independent cohort clusters, including 40 core cohorts. Across three adjusted cohorts, clinician correctness was substantially higher with correct than incorrect automated advice (pooled OR 10.19, 95% CI 7.43–13.98; I² = 0%); a ≥ 2020 sensitivity analysis was similar but imprecise (OR 9.22, 95% CI 2.06–41.13). In four heterogeneous real-world computerized ECG studies, 26.6% of erroneous interpretations were not corrected or recognized (95% CI 6.4–65.6%; I² = 95.8%).

editorial.reason: 系统综述与meta分析首次量化'人类监督'在AI出错时并非可靠防线：正确 vs 错误自动建议下临床医生正确率差异巨大（OR 10.19），真实世界心电AI错误中约26.6%未被纠正，对AI临床部署与人机协同研究设计均有直接参考。局限在于仅三个调整后队列纳入主分析、真实世界研究异质性极高（I²=95.8%），且不良事件证据仅来自单个回顾性队列。

reviews.reason: 系统综述量化了医生对错误AI建议的依从风险（错误输出下正确率大幅下降，ECG错误中约26.6%未被纠正），对临床AI部署的人机监督设计有直接参考价值；但汇集队列极少、异质性极高，结论精度有限。
reviews.support: Human oversight should be evaluated as an error-interception capability rather than assumed to ensure safety.

items.t: 胰腺癌中淋巴结靶向、mKRAS 特异性两亲疫苗：随机 2 期 AMPLIFY-7P 试验
items.te: Lymph node-targeted, mKRAS-specific amphiphile vaccine in pancreatic cancer: the randomized phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial
items.s: 在 1 期 AMPLIFY-201 试验中，Camupepimut (ELI-002 7P) 驱动突变 KRAS (mKRAS) 特异性 T 细胞反应，该反应与 mKRAS 胰腺腺癌 (PDAC) 患者的无病生存 (DFS) 和总生存 (OS) 相关。 DFS 事后多变量 Cox 回归分析表明 camupepimut 的结果有所改善（调整后的 HR 0.47，P = 0.0086），III 期疾病的结果较差（调整后的 HR 2.29，P = 0.0127），基线 CA19-9 升高（调整后的 HR 3.16，P < 0.0001）和基线循环肿瘤 DNA (ctDNA) 阳性（调整后的 HR） 5.99，P < 0.0001）。在接受 camupepimut 治疗的患者中，mKRAS 特异性 T 细胞应答较基线高 9.17 倍（82.2%，74/90）与 DFS 改善相关（HR 0.22，P < 0.0001），中位 DFS 未达到，而高于和低于 9.17 倍的中位 DFS 分别为 6.08 个月。
items.se: Camupepimut (ELI-002 7P) drives mutated KRAS (mKRAS)-specific T cell responses that correlated with disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) in patients with mKRAS pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) in the phase 1 AMPLIFY-201 trial. Post hoc multivariate Cox regression analysis of DFS indicated an improved outcome for camupepimut (adjusted HR 0.47, P = 0.0086), a worse outcome for stage III disease (adjusted HR 2.29, P = 0.0127), an elevated baseline CA19-9 (adjusted HR 3.16, P < 0.0001) and baseline circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) positivity (adjusted HR 5.99, P < 0.0001). In camupepimut-treated patients, mKRAS-specific T cell response >9.17-fold over baseline (82.2%, 74/90) correlated with improved DFS (HR 0.22, P < 0.0001), with the median DFS not reached versus 6.08 months for above and below 9.17-fold, respectively.

editorial.reason: 该随机2期试验报告mKRAS疫苗主终点DFS未达（HR 0.85, P=0.53），但提供了完整的预设亚组、ctDNA与T细胞应答相关性分析，对胰腺癌辅助免疫治疗的3期设计和生物标志物富集策略有直接参考价值。主要限制是多项阳性信号来自post hoc与探索性分析，不能视为疗效证明。

reviews.reason: 这是mKRAS特异性淋巴结靶向疫苗camupepimut在胰腺癌辅助治疗中的随机II期试验，主要终点DFS未达标，但ctDNA阴性、既往未放疗亚组及T细胞应答倍数与DFS的关联等预设与探索性分析可指导III期人群选择和免疫监测生物标志物设计。限制在于主要终点阴性、事后多变量分析有验证性不足，效果信号不能等同于临床获益。

items.t: 淋巴瘤患者多中心、多试验队列分析中 CAR T 细胞治疗反应的决定因素
items.te: Determinants of response to CAR T cell therapy in a multicenter, multi-trial cohort analysis of patients with lymphoma
items.s: 在接受嵌合抗原受体 (CAR) T 细胞疗法治疗的非霍奇金淋巴瘤 (NHL) 患者中，与疗效相关的因素与预后生物标志物重叠。高比例的幼稚样 (CCR7+CD45RA+) T 细胞是与延长无进展生存期相关的最显着特征（PFS；风险比 = 0.46，95% 置信区间：0.31−0.68，P = 9.8 × 10−5，高幼稚样 T 细胞组与低幼稚样 T 细胞组），且不影响安全性。在多变量模型中，幼稚表型优于炎症标志物和肿瘤负荷等临床病理特征，在调整产品扩展后仍然显着。主要发现在一个由 203 名接受基于 axi-cel 的疗法或 brexucabtagene autoleucel 治疗的患者组成的独立队列中得到验证。
items.se: In patients with non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) treated with chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy, factors associated with efficacy overlap with prognostic biomarkers. A high proportion of naive-like (CCR7+CD45RA+) T cells was the most significant feature associated with prolonged progression-free survival (PFS; hazard ratio = 0.46, 95% confidence interval: 0.31−0.68, P = 9.8 × 10−5, high versus low naive-like T cell groups) without impacting safety. In multivariate models, the naive-like phenotype outperformed clinicopathologic features such as inflammatory markers and tumor burden, remaining significant after adjusting for product expansion. The key findings were validated in an independent cohort of 203 patients treated with axi-cel-based therapy or brexucabtagene autoleucel.

editorial.reason: 基于580例多试验队列并经203例独立队列验证，提示输注前CAR T产品中初始样CCR7+CD45RA+ T细胞比例与PFS显著相关且独立于临床病理特征，对疗效预测标志物开发和早期干预时机决策有直接参考价值；主要局限为回顾性多试验汇总分析，因果关系尚未经前瞻性干预验证。

reviews.reason: 基于580例多试验队列加203例独立验证，明确了产品中初始样T细胞比例与CAR T疗效的关联，对细胞治疗产品质量控制、患者分层和早干预策略有直接研究价值；限制为回顾性多试验汇总分析，因果性与前瞻验证仍待确立。

items.t: 交易所资格预验证提议规则 (CMS 9873-P)
items.s: 交易所资格前验证拟议规则 (CMS 9873-P) 简介 与总统防止浪费、欺诈和滥用的目标相一致，美国卫生与公众服务部 (HHS) 今天通过医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 发布了交易所资格前验证拟议规则通知。该规则将使交易所资格和验证法规与工作家庭减税 (WFTC) 立法 (P.L. 119-21) 规定的新要求保持一致。 WFTC 立法修订了《国内税收法》，为保费税收抵免 (PTC) 制定了新的资格要求。
items.se: Exchange Pre-Eligibility Verification Proposed Rule (CMS 9873-P) Introduction Consistent with the President’s goal to prevent waste, fraud, and abuse, today the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), through the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), issued the Exchange Pre-Eligibility Verification Notice of Proposed Rulemaking. This rule would align Exchange eligibility and verification regulations with new requirements specified under the Working Families Tax Cuts (WFTC) legislation (P.L. 119-21). The WFTC legislation amended the Internal Revenue Code to establish new eligibility requirements for the premium tax credit (PTC).

editorial.reason: CMS正式发布Exchange资格预验证拟议规则，将改变2028计划年起医保市场补贴发放、年度重认证与州立Exchange过渡时间线，保险公司与交易平台需据此调整运营与合规规划。限制在于这是拟议规则，仍处30天公众意见征询期，最终条款可能调整。

items.t: 曲妥珠单抗 Rezetecan 治疗 ERBB2-低晚期乳腺癌：HORIZON-Breast06 随机临床试验。
items.te: Trastuzumab Rezetecan in ERBB2-Low Advanced Breast Cancer: The HORIZON-Breast06 Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.s: 重要性 Trastuzumab rezetecan (SHR-A1811) 在一项全球 1 期试验中显示出令人鼓舞的抗肿瘤活性，该试验涉及经过大量预处理的红细胞癌基因 B (ERBB2) 低转移性乳腺癌患者。目的 比较 ERBB2 低转移性乳腺癌患者的曲妥珠单抗瑞泽替康与医生选择的化疗方案。设计、设置和参与者 这项开放标签、随机、多中心 3 期试验在中国 73 家医院进行。符合条件的患者是年龄在 18 至 75 岁之间、集中确诊为 ERBB2 低（免疫组织化学 [IHC] 1+ 或 IHC 2+/原位杂交 [ISH] 阴性）不可切除的局部复发性或转移性乳腺癌的女性，她们之前接受过 1 种或更少的转移性疾病化疗，且激素受体阳性疾病需要先行内分泌治疗。
items.se: Importance Trastuzumab rezetecan (SHR-A1811) has demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity in a global phase 1 trial involving heavily pretreated patients with erythroblastic oncogene B (ERBB2)-low metastatic breast cancer. Objective To compare trastuzumab rezetecan vs physician's choice of chemotherapy in patients with ERBB2-low metastatic breast cancer. Design, setting, and participants This open-label, randomized, multicenter phase 3 trial was conducted at 73 hospitals across China. Eligible patients were females aged 18 to 75 years with centrally confirmed ERBB2-low (immunohistochemistry [IHC] 1+ or IHC 2+/in-situ hybridization [ISH]-negative) unresectable locally recurrent or metastatic breast cancer who had received 1 or fewer prior lines of chemotherapy for metastatic disease, with prior endocrine therapy required for hormone receptor-positive disease.

items.t: 瑞米布替尼与特立氟胺治疗复发性多发性硬化症（REMODEL-1 和 REMODEL-2）：两项随机 3 期试验。
items.te: Remibrutinib versus teriflunomide in relapsing multiple sclerosis (REMODEL-1 and REMODEL-2): two randomised, phase 3 trials.
items.s: 背景 Remibrutinib 是一种高选择性、强效、共价、中枢神经系统渗透性、口服 BTK 抑制剂。我们评估了瑞布替尼对复发性多发性硬化症成年患者的疗效和安全性。方法 REMODEL-1 和 REMODEL-2 是两项相同的、随机、双盲、双模拟、主动对照、平行组、事件驱动的 3 期试验，在 46 个国家的 407 个中心进行。通过交互式响应技术，年龄为 18-55 岁、患有复发性多发性硬化症、扩展残疾状态量表评分为 0-5·5 且有近期疾病活动证据的患者被随机分配至口服瑞布替尼 100 mg 每日两次或特立氟胺 14 mg 每日一次，以 1:1 的比例接受治疗。随机分组按地理区域、MRI 队列参与情况和多发性硬化症亚型进行分层。患者、现场调查人员和试验团队对治疗分配情况不知情。
items.se: Background Remibrutinib is a highly selective, potent, covalent, CNS-penetrant, oral BTK inhibitor. We assessed the efficacy and safety of remibrutinib in adult patients with relapsing multiple sclerosis. Methods REMODEL-1 and REMODEL-2 are two identical, randomised, double-blind, double-dummy, active comparator-controlled, parallel-group, event-driven, phase 3 trials conducted at 407 centres in 46 countries. Patients aged 18-55 years with relapsing multiple sclerosis, an Expanded Disability Status Scale score of 0-5·5, and evidence of recent disease activity were randomly assigned 1:1 to oral remibrutinib 100 mg twice daily or teriflunomide 14 mg once daily via interactive response technology. Randomisation was stratified by geographical region, MRI cohort participation, and multiple sclerosis subtype. Patients, site investigators, and trial team were masked to treatment allocation.

editorial.reason: 两项设计严谨的3期头对头试验显示BTK抑制剂remibrutinib在复发型多发性硬化中年化复发率显著优于特立氟胺（RR约0.65-0.69），样本量大、活性对照明确，为神经免疫领域换药与治疗定位决策提供高级别证据；局限性为诺华资助、ARR差异绝对幅度小，长期安全性与残疾进展数据尚待随访。

items.t: Ravulizumab 治疗 IgA 肾病 - 3 期试验的中期分析。
items.te: Ravulizumab in IgA Nephropathy - Interim Analysis of a Phase 3 Trial.
items.s: 背景 在 IgA 肾病患者中，补体激活会导致肾小球炎症，从而导致血尿、蛋白尿和肾单位丢失。第 34 周时，与安慰剂组 (-5.6%) 相比，ravulizumab 组观察到几何平均 24 小时尿蛋白与肌酐比值显着降低 (-46.6%)，对应调整后的 ravulizumab 组几何平均 24 小时尿蛋白与肌酐比值比使用 ravulizumab 组低 43.4%（99% 置信区间，30.1 至 54.2）。安慰剂（P < 0.001）。
items.se: Background In patients with IgA nephropathy, complement activation drives glomerular inflammation, which leads to hematuria, proteinuria, and nephron loss. At week 34, a significant reduction in the geometric mean 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio was observed with ravulizumab (-46.6%) as compared with the reduction observed with placebo (-5.6%), corresponding to an adjusted geometric mean 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio that was 43.4% (99% confidence interval, 30.1 to 54.2) lower with ravulizumab than with placebo (P < 0.001).

items.t: Povetacicept 治疗 IgA 肾病 3 期试验的中期分析。
items.te: Interim Analysis of a Phase 3 Trial of Povetacicept in IgA Nephropathy.
items.s: 背景 B 细胞激活因子 (BAFF) 和增殖诱导配体 (APRIL) 在产生 IgA 的 B 细胞群中具有独特的作用，并且似乎是 IgA 肾病发病机制的核心。到第36周时，povetacicept组的24小时尿蛋白与肌酐比值下降了52.0%，安慰剂组下降了4.3%（调整后的差异，-49.8个百分点；95%置信区间[CI]，-58.6至-39.2；P < 0.001）。
items.se: Background B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and a proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL) have distinct roles in IgA-producing B-cell populations and appear to be central to the pathogenesis of IgA nephropathy. The 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio decreased by 52.0% with povetacicept and by 4.3% with placebo by week 36 (adjusted difference, -49.8 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -58.6 to -39.2; P < 0.001).

editorial.reason: III期双盲安慰剂对照试验的中期分析，557例入组、199例疗效分析显示尿蛋白肌酐比下降52.0% vs 4.3%，为IgA肾病BAFF/APRIL双靶点抑制提供了高质量替代终点证据。局限为替代终点（尿蛋白）而非硬终点，且样本为疗效分析子集，长期肾脏结局待验证。

items.t: 活体肾脏捐赠后的妊娠结果。
items.te: Pregnancy Outcomes After Living Kidney Donation.
items.s: 尽管证据尚不清楚，但活体肾脏捐赠后怀孕的人发生妊娠相关不良后果的风险可能会增加。确定活体肾脏捐赠后的妊娠是否与非捐赠者中的匹配妊娠相比不良妊娠结局的风险更高。这项匹配队列研究使用了加拿大安大略省、不列颠哥伦比亚省和阿尔伯塔省的省级行政医疗保健数据库，纳入了年龄在 18 岁至 42 岁之间的活体女性肾脏捐献者，她们在 1992 年 7 月至 2021 年 8 月期间捐献了肾脏，随后进行了至少 20 周妊娠的单胎妊娠。这些妊娠与女性非捐赠者中妊娠至少 20 周的单胎妊娠按 1:4 进行匹配。
items.se: People who become pregnant after living kidney donation may be at increased risk of pregnancy-related adverse outcomes, although the evidence is unclear. To determine whether pregnancies after living kidney donation are associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes than matched pregnancies among nondonors. This matched cohort study used provincial administrative health care databases from Ontario, British Columbia, and Alberta, Canada, and included living female kidney donors aged 18 to 42 years who donated a kidney between July 1992 and August 2021 and subsequently had singleton pregnancies of at least 20 weeks' gestation. These pregnancies were matched 1:4 with singleton pregnancies of at least 20 weeks' gestation among female nondonors.

editorial.reason: 大样本匹配队列（385例捐肾者妊娠对1540例对照）量化了活体供肾后妊娠的高血压疾病及小于胎龄儿风险（RR 1.51和1.86），对供者知情同意与产前管理有直接指导价值；属观察性数据，且多数妊娠结局良好，不宜外推为因果。

items.t: 利妥昔单抗与硫唑嘌呤治疗嗜酸性肉芽肿伴多血管炎维持治疗：一项随机临床试验。
items.te: Rituximab vs Azathioprine for Eosinophilic Granulomatosis With Polyangiitis Maintenance Therapy: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.s: 重要性 对于嗜酸性肉芽肿性多血管炎 (EGPA) 患者，指南建议在缓解后考虑维持治疗。目的 比较利妥昔单抗和硫唑嘌呤维持治疗对经过标准治疗（包括泼尼松逐渐减量或停药）后最近获得血管炎缓解的 EGPA 患者缓解持续时间的影响。
items.se: Importance For patients with eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA), guidelines recommend considering maintenance therapy after achieving remission. Objective To compare the effects of rituximab and azathioprine maintenance therapies on remission duration for patients with EGPA who recently achieved remission of vasculitis after standard therapy, including prednisone tapering or withdrawal.

editorial.reason: 针对EGPA维持治疗的随机双盲试验，为利妥昔单抗 vs 硫唑嘌呤提供首个头对头证据，阴性主结局（缓解时长无差异）直接影响维持治疗策略选择；且利妥昔单抗组严重感染更多，对风险获益权衡有实际参考。局限为样本量98、缓解比例低，次要终点均未达显著。

reviews.support: rituximab was not superior to azathioprine for improving the duration of total remission during 28 months

reviews.reason: 这是首个比较利妥昔单抗与硫唑嘌呤作为EGPA维持治疗的随机双盲试验，结果为阴性——两组缓解持续时间无差异且利妥昔单抗组严重感染更多，直接挑战将RTX作为维持治疗的惯例。98例多中心设计和94%完成率使证据可信，可作为维持治疗决策和后续研究设计的关键参照。
reviews.support: rituximab was not superior to azathioprine for improving the duration of total remission during 28 months while taking prednisone at 7.5 mg/d or less

items.t: Sibeprenlimab 治疗 IgA 肾病 - 最终 3 期试验分析。
items.te: Sibeprenlimab in IgA Nephropathy - Final Phase 3 Trial Analysis.
items.s: 背景 Sibeprenlimab 是一种人源化单克隆抗体，选择性抑制细胞因子 A 增殖诱导配体 (APRIL)，这是 IgA 肾病的关键驱动因素。西贝普伦利单抗组的 24 个月年化 eGFR 斜率为每年每 1.73 m 2 体表面积 0.3 ml/分钟（95% 置信区间 [CI]，-0.4 至 0.9），而安慰剂组的年化 eGFR 斜率为每年每 1.73 m 2 体表面积 -4.2 ml/分钟（95% CI，-4.9 至 -3.6）（组间差异，每年每分钟 4.5 ml）。每年 1.73 m 2；95% CI，3.6 至 5.4；P < 0.001）。
items.se: Background Sibeprenlimab, a humanized monoclonal antibody, selectively inhibits the cytokine A proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL), a key driver of IgA nephropathy. The annualized eGFR slope over 24 months was 0.3 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 of body-surface area per year (95% confidence interval [CI], -0.4 to 0.9) with sibeprenlimab and -4.2 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 per year (95% CI, -4.9 to -3.6) with placebo (between-group difference, 4.5 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 per year; 95% CI, 3.6 to 5.4; P < 0.001).

editorial.reason: VISIONARY III期最终分析提供了sibeprenlimab稳定IgA肾病患者eGFR斜率的完整24个月数据（组间差异4.5 ml/min/1.73m²/年），是IgA肾病靶向治疗的重要硬终点证据；材料为摘要级，长期肾功能获益与安全性细节需全文核实。

items.t: Atacicept 治疗 IgA 肾病 - 3 期试验最终疗效分析。
items.te: Atacicept in IgA Nephropathy - Phase 3 Trial Final Efficacy Analysis.
items.s: 背景 在此试验 ORIGIN 3 之前发表的分析中，与安慰剂相比，Atacicept 导致尿蛋白与肌酐比值显着降低。第 52 周时，eGFR 的平均变化为每 1.73 m 2 体表面积每分钟 -0.11 ml（95% 置信区间 [CI]，-1.44 至 1.22），atacicept 组和每分钟 -5.69 ml 体表面积。 1.73 m 2 （95% CI，-7.04 至 -4.35）与安慰剂（平均差异，每 1.73 m 2 每分钟 5.58 ml；95% CI，3.68 至 7.48；P < 0.001）。
items.se: Background Atacicept resulted in a significantly greater reduction in the urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio than placebo in a previously published analysis of this trial, ORIGIN 3. At week 52, the mean change in the eGFR was -0.11 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 of body-surface area (95% confidence interval [CI], -1.44 to 1.22) with atacicept and -5.69 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 (95% CI, -7.04 to -4.35) with placebo (mean difference, 5.58 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 ; 95% CI, 3.68 to 7.48; P < 0.001).

editorial.reason: III期试验最终eGFR分析显示atacicept组年均eGFR斜率较安慰剂改善约5 ml/min/1.73m²，为IgA肾病的肾功能硬终点提供了新的关键证据。局限为仅摘要级信息、次要终点结果且经费来自企业，需关注完整安全性数据与长期获益。
